text:
Goal
make the user lookup idempotent and cache safe
Context
concurrent requests currently hit the database simultaneously causing pool exhaustion
Constraints
do not modify database schema
cache ttl must not exceed sixty seconds
Done
load test shows zero pool exhaustion under five hundred concurrent requests

Goal
refactor the payment refund handler to use atomic transactions
Context
partial refund failures leave order records in inconsistent state
Constraints
must wrap external gateway call and database write
never log credit card numbers or secrets
Done
integration tests pass ten times consecutively with simulated gateway errors

Goal
implement backpressure in the event stream consumer
Context
heavy burst ingestion crashes workers with out of memory errors
Constraints
pause consumption when buffer reaches one thousand messages
resume only after buffer drops below two hundred
Done
consumer runs without memory growth during thirty minute soak test

Goal
add tenant isolation to the product catalog queries
Context
multi tenant deployment must prevent cross tenant data leakage
Constraints
filter by tenant id on every select query
do not rely on application layer filtering alone
Done
test suite asserts cross tenant access attempts return empty results

Goal
optimize the search autocomplete endpoint latency
Context
p99 latency currently exceeds two hundred milliseconds on mobile
Constraints
response time must stay under thirty milliseconds
do not introduce external search infrastructure
Done
benchmark report confirms p99 latency below twenty five milliseconds

Goal
replace synchronous file writes with non blocking append stream
Context
request threads block during disk io spikes under high concurrency
Constraints
maintain chronological line ordering
flush buffer every two seconds
Done
throughput benchmark shows zero blocked worker threads under load

Goal
fix flaky race condition in session expiry test suite
Context
test fails intermittently in continuous integration environments
Constraints
do not use arbitrary sleep or timeout calls
use fake clock or explicit synchronization
Done
test suite passes one hundred times in a loop without single failure

Goal
implement circuit breaker for the third party geocoding api
Context
geocoding outages cascade and degrade core checkout experience
Constraints
trip breaker after five consecutive timeouts
fallback to cached postal code coordinates
Done
simulated outage returns cached coordinates within ten milliseconds

Goal
split large database migration into zero downtime batches
Context
locking the users table blocks web traffic during deployment
Constraints
migrate ten thousand rows per batch
sleep two hundred milliseconds between batches
Done
migration completes while read traffic experiences zero lock timeouts

Goal
enforce strict rate limiting on the password reset endpoint
Context
brute force attempts against reset tokens detected in traffic logs
Constraints
maximum five attempts per email per hour
return generic status code regardless of email existence
Done
sixth attempt from same ip returns four two nine too many requests

Goal
migrate authentication secrets to environment variables
Context
hardcoded api keys found in repository history during security review
Constraints
fail fast at application startup if secrets missing
never commit default keys to version control
Done
application starts successfully with provided environment configuration

Goal
add structured json logging to the order processing pipeline
Context
unstructured text logs make correlation across microservices difficult
Constraints
include trace id and span id on every log line
exclude customer payment details
Done
log validator verifies all emitted lines parse as valid json objects

Goal
prune orphaned storage blobs uploaded by abandoned sessions
Context
storage costs increasing due to incomplete file uploads
Constraints
only delete blobs created more than twenty four hours ago
run cleanup as low priority background job
Done
cleanup job deletes orphaned test blobs while leaving active files intact

Goal
implement optimistic concurrency control on inventory counts
Context
concurrent purchases result in overselling limited stock items
Constraints
use version number check on update
retry conflict up to three times before failing
Done
concurrency test proves exactly twenty items sold from stock of twenty

Goal
defer email dispatch to background task queue
Context
waiting for smtp connection delays response to client
Constraints
return immediate response to user
retry failed email delivery with backoff
Done
api response time drops below one hundred milliseconds

Goal
validate webhook payloads with hmac signature check
Context
forged webhook requests could trigger unauthorized account updates
Constraints
use timing safe comparison function
reject timestamps older than five minutes
Done
test verifies valid signatures accepted and forged ones rejected with four zero one

Goal
add database health check probe for orchestrator readiness
Context
orchestrator routes traffic before database pool is initialized
Constraints
probe must execute lightweight ping query
timeout after two seconds
Done
probe returns two hundred when connected and five zero three when database down

Goal
extract currency conversion logic into standalone pure function
Context
currency rounding bugs found across billing and invoicing modules
Constraints
no external api calls inside calculation
use integer cents to avoid floating point drift
Done
unit tests verify precision across twenty currency pairs

Goal
implement graceful shutdown for worker process
Context
terminating workers mid task leaves queue items in locked state
Constraints
allow current task thirty seconds to finish
refuse new tasks after sigterm received
Done
simulated termination allows running task to finish and re-queues others

Goal
add gzip compression to static asset responses
Context
large javascript bundles increase initial page load times
Constraints
compress files larger than one kilobyte
cache compressed output on disk
Done
http response headers confirm content encoding is gzip for bundle files
